summary: Ansible 9 community.aws breaking changes: botocore<1.29.0 and boto3<1.26.0 unsupported, Python<3.7 support removed, and aws_region_info, aws_s3_bucket_info, iam_access_key and iam_access_key_info migrated to amazon.aws.
questions: Which boto3 does community.aws need in Ansible 9?
Where did iam_access_key_info move in Ansible 9?
